metadata.title: Charity Project
metadata.description: The Charity Project is an independent and global solidarity initiative that supports people and families in vulnerable situations, with essential goods, health support and connections to donors.
metadata.ogDescription: Independent and global solidarity initiative: essential goods, health support and connection between donors and beneficiaries.

home.heroSubtitle: An independent, global solidarity initiative that supports people and families in vulnerable situations, wherever they are.
home.aboutP1: The Charity Project is an initiative that aims to support people and families in situations of social vulnerability with the provision of essential goods, support for physical and mental health and connection with donors.
home.aboutP2: It is a concrete expression of solidarity in action, based on the principles of human dignity and care for those most in need, without distinction of origin, creed or nationality. We believe that small gestures of solidarity can transform lives and restore human dignity.
home.eixo1Desc: Donation of food, clothing and hygiene products to families in vulnerable situations.
home.eixo2Desc: Consultations with health professionals and psychological support for those who need it most.
home.eixo3Desc: Platform for connecting specific needs and donors willing to help.
home.helpSubtitle: There are several ways to contribute to the Charity Project. Every gesture of solidarity makes a difference in the lives of those who need it most.
home.helpVolunteerDesc: Donate your time and talents to help with the project’s various activities.
home.helpGoodsDesc: Contribute food, clothing, hygiene products and other essential items.
home.helpMoneyDesc: Make a financial contribution to help keep the projects running.
home.testimonial1Quote: When I lost my job during the pandemic, I didn't know how I was going to feed my three children. The Charity Project not only provided us with food, but also helped me find a new job. I will be eternally grateful.
home.testimonial2Quote: Volunteering at Projecto Caridade transformed my worldview. Seeing the direct impact we can have on people's lives is a priceless experience. Every smile we receive is our greatest reward.
home.testimonial3Quote: As a doctor, I always wanted to help beyond the office. At Projecto Caridade, I can offer assistance to those who really don't have access. It is gratifying to see the recovery of people who, without this support, would not be able to take care of their health.
home.testimonial4Quote: My company started donating monthly to Projecto Caridade and we decided to visit to see the work up close. We were impressed by the seriousness and real impact that each contribution has. It is work that deserves our full support.

privacidade.title: Privacy Policy
privacidade.metaDescription: Find out what personal data Projecto Caridade collects, for what purposes, for how long and how to exercise your rights.
privacidade.intro: This policy explains how Projecto Caridade processes the personal data of those who visit the website, sign up as a volunteer, ask for support, contact us or use the portal and app. We process data from people in vulnerable situations and we take this responsibility seriously: we collect only what is necessary, protect the information and respect their rights.

seccoes.titulo: 1. Who is responsible for the processing
paragrafos: The person responsible for processing the data is Projecto Caridade, with the contact details indicated in the footer of this website.
For any questions about privacy or to exercise your rights, write to info@caridade.ao or use the [rights form](/direitos-dados).

We process data in accordance with Law No. 22/11, of 17 June (Personal Data Protection Law of Angola) and, when applicable, with the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union (Regulation (EU) 2016/679).

itens: Volunteer registration: name, email, country, telephone, area of ​​interest and message.

Beneficiary registration: name, date of birth, document number, country, telephone, email, address, number of adults and children in the household, description of the situation and types of support needed.
Contact: name, email, country, telephone, subject and message.
Newsletter: email.
Account on the portal or app: name, email, desired and assigned profile, account status, password (only stored in an irreversible encrypted form), date of last access and active sessions.
Support requests (beneficiaries with account): subject, description and status.
Team operational records: campaigns, stock, deliveries of goods, referrals, prevention actions, needs and donations, which may contain names and contact details.
Usage statistics, only if you accept statistical cookies (see section 6).

seccoes.titulo: 3. What we use the data for and on what basis
itens: Evaluate requests and provide support to beneficiaries — with their explicit consent.
Manage applications and the collaboration of volunteers and professionals — with your consent and to follow up on your request.
Respond to messages and requests for information — legitimate interest in responding and consent.
Send the newsletter — with your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
Manage accounts, authentication and portal security — necessary to provide the service you requested and legitimate interest in security.
Organize internal activity and report on the support provided — legitimate interest of a non-profit organization, with guarantees of confidentiality.
Comply with legal obligations, including responding to requests to exercise rights.
paragrafos: We do not use your data for advertising, we do not sell it and we do not make automated decisions that affect you.

The description of the social situation and health needs of beneficiaries are sensitive data. We only process them with your express and separate consent, only to evaluate and provide support, and only coordination people with a need to know them have access to them.
We ask that you do not include diagnoses, exams or clinical documents on the forms. You can withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the processing already carried out.

Access to data is only through our servers and is limited by each person's profile (administration, coordination, volunteer, professional or beneficiary). Passwords are stored with irreversible encryption, sessions can be revoked and there are limits against abusive attempts.
We don't send recovery emails: if you lose access, an administrator will deliver a single-use access code to you via a secure channel.
We use encrypted connections (HTTPS) and infrastructure with data encryption at rest.
We only use the cookies and local storage necessary for the website to function (language, portal session and recording your choice of cookies).

Only with your consent do we use Google Analytics to measure, in aggregate form, how the site is used. You can accept, reject or change your choice at any time in “Cookie preferences” in the footer. Find out more at [Cookie Policy](/politica-cookies).

seccoes.titulo: 7. Who we share the data with
itens: Members of the Projecto Caridade team, according to their profile and as necessary.
Google Cloud / Firebase (Google), which provides hosting and database services on our behalf, under data processing agreements.
Google Analytics (Google), only if you consent to statistical cookies.
Public authorities, when the law requires it.

seccoes.titulo: 8. Where data and international transfers are located
paragrafos: The site is served from data centers in the European Union (Netherlands) and the database is hosted in Google data centers in South Africa. Google Analytics statistics, where authorized, may be processed in the United States.

These transfers are made with the contractual guarantees provided by Google (including standard contractual clauses) and, when required by applicable law, with the authorizations of the data protection authorities.

seccoes.titulo: 9. How long do we keep the data
itens: Contact messages: 24 months.
Volunteer registration: 36 months.
Newsletter: until you withdraw consent.
Beneficiary registrations and support requests and delivery records: 60 months after the last support, after which they are anonymized.
Accounts: while they are active; accounts without access for 24 months are reviewed and deleted.
Requests to exercise rights: 36 months after response.
Technical security sessions and records: automatically deleted in days or hours.
Know what data we have about you and obtain a copy (access and portability).
Correct incorrect or incomplete data (rectification).
Request the deletion of your data (deletion).
Request limitation of treatment or oppose it.
Withdraw consent at any time.
paragrafos: You can exercise these rights in the [rights form](/direitos-dados), by email to info@caridade.ao or, if you have an account, in “My account” (export the data or delete the account). We will respond within 30 days and may ask you to confirm your identity.

If you consider that your data has not been processed correctly, you can lodge a complaint with the Angolan Data Protection Agency (APD) or, if you reside in the European Union, with the data protection authority in your country. We appreciate you contacting us first so we can try to resolve the situation.
Accounts on the portal and app are intended for people aged 16 or over. Of the minors who are part of a household, we only record the number of children, without identifying them.
We may update this policy. The date and current version are shown at the top of this page; If the changes are material, we will ask for your consent again when necessary.

exclusao.title: Data Deletion Instructions
exclusao.intro: In accordance with data protection laws, Projecto Caridade guarantees your right to request the deletion of all your personal information from our databases.
exclusao.howIntro: To request the deletion of your data (such as beneficiary registration data, volunteer registrations or contact details), please follow the following steps:
steps: Send an email to info@caridade.ao with the subject “Data Deletion Request”.
In the body of the email, please include your full name and the email address and/or phone number you used on our forms.
Specify whether you want to delete all your data or just those from a specific section (e.g. unsubscribe from volunteering).
exclusao.deadlineBody: Our team will process your request as quickly as possible and within a maximum period of 15 working days. You will receive a confirmation email once the deletion is complete.
exclusao.afterBody: Once deletion is confirmed, your personal data will be permanently deleted from our systems, such as Firebase Firestore and email databases. If it is an ongoing case (for example, a social assistance case), deleting the data will discontinue the case and our ability to evaluate it will be interrupted.
exclusao.metaDescription: How to request the deletion of your personal data from Projecto Caridade and within what period we will respond.

cookiesPolicy.title: Cookies Policy
cookiesPolicy.metaDescription: What cookies and local storage does the Projecto Caridade website use, what are they for and how to manage your preferences.
cookiesPolicy.intro: Cookies are small files saved by the browser. We only use those necessary for the website to function and, only with your consent, statistical cookies.

itens: NEXT_LOCALE — remembers the chosen language. Duration: browser session.
__Host-caridade-sessao — keeps the session logged in to the portal (/admin); It is only created when you log in. Duration: up to 7 days or until the session ends.
charity-consent (local storage) — saves your choice about cookies. Duration: 6 months.
_ga — Google Analytics: distinguishes visitors pseudonymously. Duration: up to 2 years.
_ga_<identificador> — Google Analytics: Maintains statistics session state. Duration: up to 2 years.
paragrafos: These cookies are only created after accepting “Statistics”. We use Google Analytics with IP anonymization and without advertising signals. If you withdraw consent, we will stop sending data and delete these cookies.

You can change your choice at any time using the button below or in “Cookie preferences” in the footer. You can also delete cookies in your browser settings. More information in [Privacy Policy](/politica-privacidade).

cookies.title: Cookies and privacy
cookies.text: We use cookies necessary for the website to function. With your permission, we also use statistical cookies (Google Analytics) to understand how the website is used. You can change your mind at any time. Find out more at <link>Cookies Policy</link>.
